concepts.proposed_markdown: For Adyen's framework entity onboarding route, a common holding entity is the main contracting entity added as a company account, while affiliated processing entities are added as merchant accounts. The guide says the holding entity generally does not process payments; this route-specific mapping does not establish a particular merchant of record, contractual allocation, or live eligibility. [[source-adyen-docs-account-define-account-structure-framework-onboarding]]
warnings: Keep framework-onboarding mapping scoped to the dated guide; the holding-entity nonprocessing statement is qualified by 'generally'.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-define-account-structure-framework-onboarding]] — 2026-09-15 framework-entity onboarding guide mapping holding/processing legal entities to company/merchant accounts and requiring Adyen approval before go-live.
